kind: correction (two integrity defects in the 0006 round)
at_utc_meaning: Time this record's content was written, before its commit; the commit time is in git.
precedent: records/0003-correction-pcc-history-rewrite.json: a correction is a new record and the earlier record's bytes are preserved.

correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.difference: The declared time is 2 min 15 s AFTER the commit, so the record was forward-dated relative to its own commit.
correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.cause: I wrote at_utc as an estimate of the commit time before committing, and did not replace it with an observed time.
correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.materiality: Immaterial to the prediction. FY2026 category-329 was 0 at 22:00:11Z (quoted in 0006), 22:02:44Z and 22:02:47Z, and both times are long before any reveal. The prediction's content, quantity and range are unaffected.
correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.corrected_reading: Read 0006 as committed at 2026-11-05T22:02:45Z. Its content was written between the 22:00:11Z check and that commit.
correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.why_new_record_not_edit: Editing 0006 would change its bytes and its sha256 (db637e83...), which have been published and cited. The README's rule is to preserve original JSON bytes and add a new numbered record. An edit would make the chain unverifiable for anyone holding the old hash.
correction_1_record_0006_at_utc.practice_change: From record 0007 on, at_utc is an observed time taken before the record is written (0007: the zero-count check at 22:09:04Z), never later than the commit.

correction_2_zero_count_log_write_method.disclosure: This log is described as append-only, but it is rewritten with its existing bytes preserved, not truly appended. Opening the file for append on the UC volume (FUSE mount) fails with 'OSError: [Errno 29] Illegal seek'. Each update reads the whole file and writes it back as old bytes plus new lines, then checks that the old bytes are an unchanged prefix.

before.note: hash of the whole 2-line file, observed just before the rewrite

rewrite_1.verification: Checked at 2026-11-05T22:11Z: the first 2 lines of the 4-line file (327 bytes) hash to 8260b137...f1717, the same as the whole pre-rewrite file, so the two pre-existing lines are byte-identical.
rewrite_1.defect_in_lines_3_4: Line 3 (22:02:44Z) has nih_fy2026_total null because that check did not query the NIH total. Neither line 3 nor line 4 recorded the write method.

rewrite_2.added: the three record-0007 checks: 22:09:04Z, 22:10:02Z, 22:10:04Z, all cat329 0; each line carries write_method
rewrite_2.verification: The first 947 bytes of the new file are byte-identical to the old file (sha256 61ef1408...).

correction_2_zero_count_log_write_method.append_only_alternatives: The UC volume path cannot be appended. A genuinely append-only store would be a Delta table with delta.appendOnly = true, which rejects UPDATE and DELETE, or a git-tracked log with fast-forward-only pushes, whose history is append-only and externally timestamped by GitHub. Neither is set up. Until one is, this file's integrity rests on the prefix-hash checks recorded here.
correction_2_zero_count_log_write_method.scheduled_writer: The daily scheduled check (task id 5e7c98c8a53f46e8aebc66407ceafbfc) also writes to this file. I have not inspected how it writes, so I do not claim it appends.
